faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Deendayal Port Authority Pilot recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the Deendayal Port Authority Pilot recruitment is 17th October 2026. Ensure all details are accurate before the deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Pilot post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 8 vacancies announced for the Pilot position by the Deendayal Port Authority in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum qualification required for the Pilot post?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a Certificate of Competency as Master of a foreign-going ship and possess one year of experience as Master/Chief Officer of a foreign-going ship.

faq.question: Q4. What is the maximum age limit for the Pilot post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applying to the Pilot post is 40 years. Age relaxation is applicable as per government norms.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Pilot position?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Pilot post will receive a salary in the range of Rs. 70,000 to Rs. 2,00,000 per month.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, the official notification states that there is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Pilot recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process includes a Written Test (if applicable), a Personal Interview, and Document Verification.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be downloaded from the "Important Links" section provided in this article. It contains all detailed information.

faq.question: Q9. What is the mode of application for the Pilot post?
faq.answer: Applications for the Deendayal Port Authority Pilot recruitment must be submitted online through the official website or the provided application link.

faq.question: Q10. Which organization is conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: This recruitment is being conducted by the Deendayal Port Authority, located in Gandhidham, Gujarat.
